name: Kondou Takeshi
source:
He is a typical bad boy with a strong temperament, just like you would find anywhere else. He is also a very perverted kid with a serious fondness for tits.

Although he is very passionate, he also has a weak temperament. The fact that he refers to himself as "boku" is also evidence that he has not yet grown up.

He has been selfish up until now, thinking of Yuka as his mother. However, his feelings for Yuka are not limited to her aren't familial, he views Yuka as a woman.

Then, the "search for a maman" interrupts his everyday life. What will happen to the sensitive and perverted boy?

[spoiler]All maman candidates were once un willing sex slaves to his late father, who deceived them under the guise of having a normal relationship. [/spoiler]
